rules.name: cash-refresh-13-phi-future-extra-row-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT trade_id, client_code, contract_number, derivative_type, product_code, currency, value_date, settlement_date, transaction_date, maturity_date, netting_status, netting_date, is_premium_paid, original_lots, active_lots, original_premium, mult_factor, nc_factor, fx_nc_factor, settle_price, CASE WHEN settle_price IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE 'VALUE' END AS settle_price_state FROM dbsystemuat.helper_cash_balance_report_view_cfs WHERE value_date = :valueDate AND settlement_date = :cob AND upper(trim(client_code)) = 'PHI' AND upper(trim(derivative_type)) = 'FUTURE' AND upper(trim(product_code)) = 'KO' ORDER BY trade_id

SELECT trade_id, client_code, contract_number, derivative_type, product_code, currency, value_date, settlement_date, transaction_date, maturity_date, netting_status, netting_date, is_premium_paid, original_lots, active_lots, original_premium, mult_factor, nc_factor, fx_nc_factor, settle_price, CASE WHEN settle_price IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE 'VALUE' END AS settle_price_state FROM opera.fn_cash_balance_report_for_scope(:tenant, 'CFS') WHERE value_date = :valueDate AND settlement_date = :cob AND upper(trim(client_code)) = 'PHI' AND upper(trim(derivative_type)) = 'FUTURE' AND upper(trim(product_code)) = 'KO' ORDER BY trade_id

SELECT s.security_id, COALESCE(f.underlying_id, '(none)') AS price_underlying_id, s.derivative_type, s.maturity_date, s.underlying1_id, f.value_date AS price_date, f.last_price FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_security_info_table_cfs s LEFT JOIN dbsystemuat.futures_price_table f ON f.underlying_id IN (s.security_id, s.underlying1_id) AND f.value_date = s.maturity_date WHERE s.security_id IN ( SELECT d.security_id FROM dbsystemuat.deal_ticket_table_with_fy_premium_view_cfs d WHERE d.trade_id IN ( SELECT r.trade_id FROM dbsystemuat.helper_cash_balance_report_view_cfs r WHERE r.value_date = :valueDate AND r.settlement_date = :cob AND upper(trim(r.client_code)) = 'PHI' AND upper(trim(r.derivative_type)) = 'FUTURE' AND upper(trim(r.product_code)) = 'KO')) ORDER BY s.security_id, price_underlying_id

SELECT s.security_id, COALESCE(f.underlying_id, '(none)') AS price_underlying_id, s.derivative_type, s.maturity_date, s.underlying1_id, f.value_date AS price_date, f.last_price FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table s LEFT JOIN opera.futures_price_table f ON f.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND f.underlying_id IN (s.security_id, s.underlying1_id) AND f.value_date = s.maturity_date WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant AND s.business_unit = 'CFS' AND s.security_id IN ( SELECT d.security_id FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table d WHERE d.tenant_id = :tenant AND d.business_unit = 'CFS' AND d.trade_id IN ( SELECT r.trade_id FROM opera.fn_cash_balance_report_for_scope(:tenant, 'CFS') r WHERE r.value_date = :valueDate AND r.settlement_date = :cob AND upper(trim(r.client_code)) = 'PHI' AND upper(trim(r.derivative_type)) = 'FUTURE' AND upper(trim(r.product_code)) = 'KO')) ORDER BY s.security_id, price_underlying_id

SELECT s.security_id, COALESCE(f.underlying_id, '(none)') AS price_underlying_id, s.derivative_type, s.maturity_date, s.underlying1_id, f.value_date AS price_date, f.last_price FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table s LEFT JOIN opera_backup_04_10.futures_price_table f ON f.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND f.underlying_id IN (s.security_id, s.underlying1_id) AND f.value_date = s.maturity_date WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant AND s.business_unit = 'CFS' AND s.security_id IN ( SELECT d.security_id FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table d WHERE d.tenant_id = :tenant AND d.business_unit = 'CFS' AND d.trade_id IN ( SELECT r.trade_id FROM opera.fn_cash_balance_report_for_scope(:tenant, 'CFS') r WHERE r.value_date = :valueDate AND r.settlement_date = :cob AND upper(trim(r.client_code)) = 'PHI' AND upper(trim(r.derivative_type)) = 'FUTURE' AND upper(trim(r.product_code)) = 'KO')) ORDER BY s.security_id, price_underlying_id

SELECT h.security_id, h.value_date, h.settle_price FROM dbsystemuat.historical_security_settlement_value_table_cfs h WHERE h.value_date BETWEEN :fromDate AND :valueDate AND h.security_id IN ( SELECT d.security_id FROM dbsystemuat.deal_ticket_table_with_fy_premium_view_cfs d WHERE d.trade_id IN ( SELECT r.trade_id FROM dbsystemuat.helper_cash_balance_report_view_cfs r WHERE r.value_date = :valueDate AND r.settlement_date = :cob AND upper(trim(r.client_code)) = 'PHI' AND upper(trim(r.derivative_type)) = 'FUTURE' AND upper(trim(r.product_code)) = 'KO')) ORDER BY h.security_id, h.value_date

SELECT c.security_id, c.value_date, c.settle_price FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = 'CFS' AND c.value_date BETWEEN :fromDate AND :valueDate AND c.security_id IN ( SELECT d.security_id FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table d WHERE d.tenant_id = :tenant AND d.business_unit = 'CFS' AND d.trade_id IN ( SELECT r.trade_id FROM opera.fn_cash_balance_report_for_scope(:tenant, 'CFS') r WHERE r.value_date = :valueDate AND r.settlement_date = :cob AND upper(trim(r.client_code)) = 'PHI' AND upper(trim(r.derivative_type)) = 'FUTURE' AND upper(trim(r.product_code)) = 'KO')) ORDER BY c.security_id, c.value_date
